title: Chapter 549
paragraphs: Chapter 549
Episode 145. Omen (18)
Now, Runcandel was closer than before, assessing the overall situation. Nobody on the battlefield was aware of their location because Ron and Kelliark were in full confrontation.
The battlefield looked like the sky had exploded in its entirety, creating a chaotic scene. The knights of Runcandel, who were watching, could not help but shudder.
"Ron Hairan……."
Rosa spoke in a low voice.
Unlike herself, her voice was filled with regret. The reason for such regret was clear.
If the House Lord, Chiron Runcandel, Luna, and the old Black Knights were here at this moment. And if only Ron Hairan had wanted Runcandel's help.
She regretted that they might have put an end to the thousand-year war between Runcandel and Zephyr today. No one could have predicted that Ron would wake up so close to Genesis.
"Acting House Lord."
The Black Knight captain, 'Stam', stood next to Rosa. He was the only person who could directly discuss participation in the war with Rosa.
"Sir Stam."
"How do you see it?"
Stam was asking whether Ron Hairan could really win in the fight against Zephyr.
"Without Kadun and Hedo, Kelliark's chances of winning do not seem high. No, even if they were there... it doesn't seem like Ron will just lose."
"I think the same. If not the House Lord, no one would be able to defeat the current Ron Hairan."
"But the reason you're still skeptical about participating in the battle is the same as mine, isn't it?"
Stam nodded his head.
Slowly but clearly.
Zephyr was falling into a state of defeat. Nevertheless, they were still maintaining a state of war excluding retreat, and they did not even send anyone to Runcandel for negotiation.
What this fact meant was clear.
"Yes, Zephyr will have a means to overturn the war situation on their own."
"Seeing that they're not even pretending to back down, it must be a very certain method. I think it's the imitation of the Origin Stone that the former House Lord mentioned."
Chiron had assessed that power as dangerous.
It was rare for him to use the expression 'dangerous'.
"We might have to be satisfied with confirming that power directly and return this time. That is, if the Black Knights who went to the Black Sea return without seeing the House Lord."
The White Stone.
Both of them judged that it would become difficult for Runcandel to possess that object the moment Ron was defeated.
If Zephyr pulls out a secret weapon and Ron fails to deal a significant blow to them, they thought they must never engage in a full-scale war.
"Acting House Lord."
"Speak."
"Would it be alright if I take three Black Knights and sneak into the battlefield?"
Stam was worried about Jin's survival. When Kelliark reveals a means to defeat Ron, he wondered whether Jin could withstand it.

They confirmed that the battlefield was divided between Ron and Kelliark, the spectral army of Octavia, and Jin's party. From the beginning, Stam had the perception that Jin was in danger even before Zephyr pulled out their secret weapon.
"Do so. It seems necessary."
"We will not intervene unless it's just before death."
"That's right. But, make sure to save them."
Blood dripped from Octavia's shoulder.
Since all the magic of the spectral army was centered around Octavia, their joint attack was bound to be somewhat dull.
Originally, it should have been so.
However, Octavia is a magician who can handle the 'attribute of light', which was known to have been completely lost long ago.

"Providence... As expected, being a dragon, you don't know much. The history of mortals, including humans, has always been an effort to resist the unjust principles and laws set by God. Changing the incurable to treatable, and the treatable to cured."
A sphere of light the size of a fist formed at the end of Octavia's staff.
When the sphere touched her shoulder, the light seeped in and the wound was rapidly healing.
"Even light magic was cut off by the gods, claiming it to be providence. They said that mortals should not possess something flawless."
Light magic is nothing less than the dream of all magicians.
The light attribute passed down like a legend can solve attack, defense, and healing at once, and its power is also different from other magic.
Likewise, the lost dark magic can do all of this, but it always requires a catalyst and a sacrifice. There was no such restriction on light. The only thing consumed as a price is magic power.
Roar!
Then, the magical power of light extended from the staff and formed wings on Octavia's back.
"So don't say that going against providence is a great sin, Black Dragon Misha. It's hard to listen because it's disgusting."
When the wings of light stretched forward, a harsh sound of wind cutting through was heard. Sharp fragments of light were shot like arrows, and Misha blocked the attack by spinning the black spear.
However, the fragments of light that bounced off in all directions caused an explosion. Misha avoided the explosion and stepped on the law magic, and the remaining warriors fended off the aftermath.

The position of Zephyr's second-in-command was not obtained for free. Although she was a little tired from landing while enduring the fight between Kelliark and Ron, only the spectral army was greatly affected by that fact.
Octavia, already a wizard who has entered the realm of 'transcendence', didn't find physical strain much of a problem. Unless she is facing an overwhelmingly powerful enemy by her standards.
"I don't understand why you're suddenly bringing up the gods. Is it difficult for you to understand that I am disgusted because what you're doing goes against my standards?"
"Life is too short to worry about such things. We are, after all, mortal beings as you've put it in your superior manner."
"And you lot are the ones who erased the history of Chenmi, the Grand Mage loved by the Light."
Creak-!
Octavia's light magic and the black spear clashed incessantly. Octavia, who had begun to use light magic in earnest, was not at all inferior to Misha in close combat.
Jin and Misha took on Octavia, while the rest dealt with the Spectral Army. Murakan was also planning to focus on Jin and Misha, but Misha barked at him.
"Hey. You just back me up while protecting our allies. It's far more efficient for you to deal with that. Don't waste your mana by attacking."
[What? Back-up mana tank? Me, Murakan? Ha! Are you insane?]
"We don't have the luxury to accommodate your feelings, so shut up and listen."
[Even so... Damn!]
Crash-!
The black spear and the light spear collided again, causing a shockwave. Misha's helmet, created by mana, partly shattered revealing her eyes, and rays of light poured out from between.
Blood splattered from underneath her eyes, resembling droplets of mana.
However, Misha also left a wound on Octavia's thigh, and Jin continued to pressure Octavia to prevent her from launching additional attacks.
"Unleash the Sword Array of the Conqueror!"

Upon Ruyan's shout, the swordsmen formed a round line and drew up their aura. The rest of the warriors were able to fight against thirty members of Jin's Spectral Army, precisely because their lives were at stake.

From then on, Murakan decided to fulfill his role as a mana tank without complaint. His wide-area attack was somewhat insufficient to penetrate the shields of the entire Spectral Army, and he was concerned that focusing on one point could put his allies in danger.
Black smoke from Murakan enveloped Misha. The black spear and armor grew even darker, and Misha's movements became more precise.
Once the Sword Array of the Conqueror was deployed, the magic of the Spectral Army could not target Jin, Misha, or Octavia at all.
The patterns on the swordsmen's bodies were growing increasingly grotesque. Their sword-wielding hands developed deep wrinkles, revealing that they were aging rapidly.
Jin was uneasy about this, but Ruyan was saying,
"Don't worry, Sir Jin. We won't fall until the end of this war."

The entire sky and ground were trembling insanely due to the shock of the war. The fallout from the aerial battle was pounding the ground like artillery, but now no other impact could intrude on the battlefield of Jin, Misha, and Octavia.
Divine King Sword Spirit Technique, 4th Sword
Corrosion
Seizing the moment, Misha launched the Spirit Technique 'Corrosion', with Jin stabbing Sigmund into the ground in front of Octavia.
Columns of electrical energy erupted, and about a thousand blue dots aimed at Octavia.
The moment Jin drew Bradamante, the thunder of Erosion rushed along the markers.
Octavia had already left the area concentrated with markers by the time the thunder began to fall, and only the afterimage of light remained where she had stood.
'I had to use the divine technique just to create an opening.'
It was not easy to create an opportunity for attack without such a technique.
The fortunate thing was that Octavia was in the same situation. She too had to unleash magic of the secret technique level just to attack Jin and Misha.
In the midst of the intertwining of the Thunder War and the Five Elements magic, the three of them were only able to confirm each other's appearances through afterimages.
Thud-!

The tip of Octavia's staff pierced someone's chest. She caused an explosion by concentrating magic at the end of her staff, and only after seeing the figure being torn apart could she identify who it was.
'Jin Runcandel? No, it must be a spirit doll made by the Black Dragon.'
Octavia calmly prepared for the next offense and defense. Looking around, she noticed that such spirit dolls were laid around her in all directions.
'Ambush......!'
Octavia couldn't assume that all of them were merely decoys or traps.
Ten dolls were each posing in different ways. They were wielding spirit swords and the Invisible Spear.
Which one was real, and whether the swordplay and spearplay displayed by the fakes were merely illusions, there was no way for Octavia to know.
'It's just a matter of handling them all at once.'
A glow gathered in her hand and staff. She intended to erase the entire battlefield where the three were fighting with a light attribute magic.
"Kaaaaaa......!"
The moment Octavia screamed, the spirit dolls rushing towards her were seen exploding or melting due to the shock wave of light.
'Were they all illusions? I can't feel any resistance.'
Then, it was determined that the attacks of the illusions were merely illusions. Thanks to this, Octavia was able to remove one element of the trap.
At that time, Jin and Misha had left the battlefield for a moment, taking advantage of the gap where the dolls were set up.
Right next to them, where their companions and the Wraith Squad were fighting.
And the two of them were able to cut off the head of one person by ambushing the rear of the Wraith Squad, which was confronting their companions.
"It's like watching a dumb bull, Octavia Zipfel. Did you really think we would focus all our power on you alone?"
Misha said with a smile, and Jin threw the head of the beheaded Wraith Squad somewhere and shrugged his shoulders.
"The Wraith Squad has no history of getting good results from meeting me. Now there are twenty-nine left, I wonder how many can survive and return."
